name: Quokkly · Gremlet #45
description:
A quokka with the happiest face on the island. Nobody knows what it's smiling about.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Quokkly in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
